components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action CTA used for quest submission, publishing, and onboarding.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: var(--accent-primary, #84cc16); color: var(--accent-primary-fg, #061109); font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #84cc16; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary hairline-bordered action for Sign In, Cancel, and inline Edit controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.12)); background: var(--bg-surface, #0e1713); color: var(--text-primary, #f1f7f3); font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-elevated, #14221b); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #84cc16; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Flat, hairline-bordered container for KPI telemetry, quests, and review items.

components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.12)); background: var(--bg-surface, #0e1713); color: var(--text-primary, #f1f7f3); padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary, #92a89c); } .ds-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-primary, #84cc16); } .ds-card-kpi { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-kpi-val { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-kpi-sub { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary, #92a89c); } .ds-progress-track { height: 8px; width: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--bg-surface-elevated, #14221b); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent-primary, #84cc16); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed canvas input field used in auth, quest search, and admin forms.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search quests or categories..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.12)); background: var(--bg-canvas, #070d0a); color: var(--text-primary, #f1f7f3); font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-secondary, #92a89c); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #84cc16; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #92a89c); font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-elevated, #14221b); color: var(--text-primary, #f1f7f3); } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--bg-surface-elevated, #14221b); color: var(--accent-primary, #84cc16); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #84cc16; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
EcoQuest is a calm, grounded, evidence-led sustainability ledger. Rather than leaning on loud gamification or glossy gradients, the interface treats real-world eco-actions like field entries: dark nocturnal surfaces recede behind crisp botanical lime actions, tabular XP/EcoPoints telemetry, and unboxed metadata.

The system defaults to a dark-first Forest Obsidian mode and pairs seamlessly with a Light Sage toggle via CSS custom properties. Surfaces rely on quiet tonal stepping and subtle hairline borders rather than drop shadows, keeping photo evidence, verification criteria, and daily quest progress immediately scannable on both mobile thumb-zones and desktop workstations.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first nocturnal canvas with a Light Sage theme parity toggle
High-contrast botanical lime primary actions paired with emerald verification states
Flat tonal layering with hairline borders instead of drop shadows
Tabular monospace numerals for all XP, EcoPoints, streaks, and confidence scores
Icon-plus-text semantic status indicators that never rely on color alone

rules.name: The Rare Lime Rule
rules.body: Canopy Lime is reserved for primary actions, active navigation/tab states, and key progress markers; never flood card backgrounds or body copy with it.

rules.name: The Semantic Clarity Rule
rules.body: Verification statuses (`approved`, `needs_review`, `rejected`, `in_progress`, `pending`) always pair a distinct Lucide icon with explicit text and semantic tint.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeric progression value (XP, level progress, EcoPoints, UTC streak days, AI confidence %) uses `JetBrains Mono` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so numbers never jitter when updated.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add `box-shadow` elevation to cards, buttons, or nav bars; convey containment with `1px` hairline borders and tonal surface steps.

dos: Do use CSS custom properties (`--bg-canvas`, `--bg-surface`, `--accent-primary`) so Dark Forest and Light Sage themes stay in lockstep.
Do pair every status color with a Lucide icon and explicit text label.
Do format all XP, EcoPoints, streak counts, and confidence scores with `JetBrains Mono` and `tabular-nums`.
Do keep quest metadata inline and unboxed (`Category · Difficulty · Duration`).
donts: Don't add drop shadows (`box-shadow`) to cards or buttons; preserve flat tonal layering.
Don't wrap every metadata tag in nested pill badges inside cards.
Don't use Canopy Lime for large background fills or long-form body text.
